newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 91-day Treasury bills yield 6.312 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 91-day Treasury bills yield 6.312 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank said on Thursday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.312 percent at its auction of 91-day Treasury bills for 80 million ringgit.
At its previous auction on January 16 for 80 million ringgit, the central bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.279 percent.
The bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.349/280 percent against 6.285/268 previously, the central bank said.
At its auction of 364-day bills, the bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.149 percent.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.175/110.
